page.overview:
Who is Hoglin?

Easy: to Normal: to Hard: to Baby:Easy and Normal: Hard:

Baby:Height: 0.7 BlocksWidth: 0.6982 Blocks

A hoglin is a breedable hostile mob found in the Nether, and a source of porkchops and leather. A hoglin attacks by thrusting its tusks upward, which can also launch its target a short distance into the air. Hoglins are repelled by warped fungi that is placed in the world as well as active nether portals and respawn anchors. They were originaly named the piglin beast in Minecon 2019 but was changed to hoglin a month later.

Baby hoglins behave similarly, but have a much weaker attack (0.25 hearts) with normal knockback, and flee when hit.
